programmes.d: Hunter and McCall follow a trail of revenge and fraud while investigating the murder of a thoroughbred racehorse.
Scali works to reunite a father with his estranged family in witness protection; a crime boss with a vendetta complicates things and the team must foil a dognapper.
A debt to a loan shark suggests that the death of a Scali-family friend was not the accident it first appeared to be. Tony puts David in jail for shoplifting.
A visit from Tony's parents uncovers a disturbing rift in their relationship.
The arrival of a shipload of Haitian "boat people" in Miami inadvertently interferes with Santana and McPike plans to catch Guzman in an illegal act.
Santana impresses Guzman with his trustworthiness and finds himself getting deeper into Guzman's operations, a move that endangers his father and Dahlia.
Santana learns the details of Guzman's money laundering operation and comes face to face with the drug lord who cost him his job as a federal prosecutor.
Hunter and McCall learn that a bizarre murder is a biochemist's effort to conceal the killing of a woman's husband in order to win her.
Hunter refuses to reveal an informant to a Grand Jury and is sent to jail, as a convicted murderer stalks the only witness against him -- Hunter's informant.

Hunter, investigating the murder of a famous movie actress, follows a contract killer to Mexico and learns why the CIA is interested in the killing.
Captain Devane tries to take Hunter and McCall off the investigation of his ex-wife's murder and violates his forced leave of absence to pursue the killer himself.
A Colombian drug dealer is murdered and police informant Sporty James becomes the prime suspect, hunted by both Hunter and the criminals.
During his trial, an accused rapist is murdered and an attempt is made on the defense attorney's life. Meanwhile, Tony fantasizes while reading "The Maltese Falcon."
A computer consultant accuses Tony of sexual harassment after he rejects her advances.
Both Tony's case and his informant are jeopardized when a con man offers evidence against the suspect in a coin heist — just for the reward.
Guzman, hiding out in El Salvador, contacts his trusted "son" Michael Santana to bring him funds.
When his brother-in-law disappears, Santana is drawn into a web of police corruption.
Hillary asks Frank and Santana for help in a lawsuit involving defective aircraft parts.
